name: The Outlets at Orange
description: The Outlets at Orange is Southern California's premier outdoor outlet destination featuring over 120 designer and brand-name stores offering savings up to 65% off retail prices. Located in the heart of Orange County near Disneyland and Angel Stadium, this open-air lifestyle outlet center combines exceptional shopping with diverse dining options and entertainment. With its convenient location at the intersection of major freeways and vibrant Spanish Colonial-inspired architecture, the center provides an upscale outlet shopping experience for locals and tourists alike.
demographics: The Outlets at Orange attracts a diverse, value-conscious shopper base spanning families and young professionals seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The primary trade area includes Orange County residents with middle to upper-middle income levels, typically aged 25-54, who prioritize quality shopping experiences while maximizing savings. The center draws from surrounding communities including Anaheim, Santa Ana, and Garden Grove, with visitors exhibiting strong cross-shopping patterns between outlet retailers and entertainment venues. The location near major tourist attractions also captures a significant tourist demographic seeking brand-name merchandise at outlet pricing.
summary: Southern California's largest open-air outlet center featuring 120+ designer brand stores with savings up to 65% off, conveniently located near major Orange County attractions.
